vented_burner_kits.summary: Burner kits ship matched to log set size. Each kit includes burner, valve (if applicable), 5/8" grate, sand/vermiculite, embers, cinder, fittings, black non-whistling flex connector. Suffix CMT = Cool Mount valve. Replace 'N' with 'P' in part # for LP.

stealth_burner_kits.notes: ANSI Z.21-60 certified. Hides valve components. Compatible with SL log kits (and RG with riser removed).

ember_supreme_burner_kits_NG_only.notes: For Mountain Timber 30"+ sets. NG only. Larger, deeper single burner pan.

double_stack_burner_kits.notes: Kodiak double stack burner. 18-36" available NG and LP. 48-60" NG only.

triple_stack_burner_kits.notes: Add-on to double-stack. 30-36 require min 25" depth, 48-60 require 31".

see_thru_burner_kits.notes: 18" deep grate, ST burner. Three-sided/corner. Needs 22" depth.

see_thru_shallow_burner_kits.notes: 12" deep grate, SS burner. Needs 17" depth.

full_pan_burner_kits.notes: Non-certified. For standard, see thru, three-sided or corner fireplaces. Min 14" depth.

outdoor_burner_kits.notes: Non-certified. Stainless steel kits, fire ring firepit kits, drop-in firepit.

vent_free_gas_logs.summary: Vent-free log sets ship as COMPLETE SETS (logs + burner + valve + flex connector all included - this is different from vented). Listed standards: ANSI Z21.11.2 (vent-free) and Z21.60 (vented). All Hargrove VF are dual-listed - can operate vent-free OR vented in masonry/listed fireplace. Replace 'N' with 'P' in part # for LP.
vent_free_gas_logs.drew_note: Hargrove VF includes flex connector, so Field Rule 1 (Empire VF needs Whisper Flex) does NOT apply here. Drew sells these but prefers White Mountain (Empire) for VF display.
